column1: Felix was going down the stairs
column2: He then found himself without God
column3: Where was he going, everyone but Felix was thinking
column4: He knew, that he Felix, will reach the peak of the mountain.
column5: Though while Felix was going up the stairs, Sven was asking himself
column6: Why dont I, Sven, go down the stairs,
column7: So Sven went down the stairs, and there he found it
column8: A big diamond, waiting to be mined, shining in the light of his torch
column9: So Sven prayed to God, to help him
column10: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
column11: And God said, Let the earth put forth grass, herbs yielding seed, [and] fruit-trees bearing fruit after their kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth: and it was so.
column12: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.
column13: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.
column14: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years:
column15: and let them be for lights in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
column16: And God made the two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: [he made] the stars also.
column17: And God set them in the firmament of heaven to give light upon the earth,
column18: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
column19: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
